name: Silk Gradient Background
description: An animated WebGL gradient background for React: slow, silky folds with a soft sheen and a thin bright seam, from three colours. Raw WebGL2, no dependencies; pauses off screen.

props.name: highlightColor
props.description: The sheen on the folds and the thin seam.

props.name: scale
props.description: Size of the folds. Higher = more, smaller folds.

props.name: seam
props.description: Brightness of the thin seam. 0 hides it.

props.name: quality
props.description: Render resolution as a share of the screen's. The folds are soft, so lower looks nearly the same and costs much less.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. It fills its parent, so give the parent a height.
